subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new global `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` prompt-context configuration surface, and if so should the no-override legacy subagent behavior remain outside the named `minimal` tier?
rationale: The PR changes a compatibility-sensitive config/session-state surface, and the current branch intentionally preserves legacy no-override filtering while exporting a resolver that describes those sessions as named tiers.

options.title: Sponsor the tier contract
options.body: Keep this PR open, decide the intended legacy-vs-tier semantics, then require the branch to align resolver behavior, docs, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Close as unconfirmed direction
options.body: Close this PR without merging while leaving the linked product request available for a maintainer-owned design pass.

options.title: Narrow to a smaller API
options.body: Ask for a smaller follow-up that avoids a new global config key and only repairs the specific bootstrap-extra-files filtering gap.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the tier contract
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, decide the intended legacy-vs-tier semantics, then require the branch to align resolver behavior, docs, and upgrade proof before merge.
